name: Elton Methodist Church

layers.essential_history: [[c:The Methodist chapel was built in 1864, replacing an older chapel on the next-door plot. One of its best-known members was James Hayes, an inventor from the village.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Elton has had both a church and a chapel for over 150 years, a sign of how lively and divided village life could be in Victorian times.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:This corner was fields in 1587. Ned Cobb is waiting for you, nervous, jingling the coins in his purse.]]

sources.title: Elton Parish Council: A short history of Elton

directions_to_next: [[c:Head south-west to Chapel Lane and the Elton Hall parkland, about 280 metres along the route. Follow the line on the map, and keep to pavements and public paths.]]

puzzle.title: [[c:Ned's purse]]
material: [[c:NED: "I charge a penny a crossing. Four people crossed tonight, so I earned four pence."]]
puzzle.question: [[c:How many pence does Ned have that he can't explain?]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:Ned has twelve pence too many: a whole shilling. Someone paid him extra that night. Ned admits Master Hale gave it to him to keep quiet.]]

evidence: [[c:Master Hale paid Ned Cobb a shilling to keep quiet about the crossings.]]
